info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v1-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscription API allows users to remove their subscriptions to weather alerts, ensuring they no longer receive notifications about specific weather conditions. This service is essential for individuals who wish to manage their alert preferences effectively. By calling this endpoint, users can streamline their communication preferences and enhance their user experience. Typical consumers include end-users of weather applications looking for personalized alert management. The API supports seamless integration into existing platforms that handle user notifications and preferences.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from their registered alerts. By making a DELETE request, the specified user will be removed from the alert notifications, ensuring they no longer receive updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details for unsubscribing from alerts. Please ensure you provide the necessary information to successfully process the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: The request body for unsubscribing from alerts.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the unsubscribe operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking the unsubscribe operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the unsubscribe action.

state.description: The current state of the unsubscribe operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the unsubscribe request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response schema for the unsubscribe operation indicating the status and details of the request.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the unsubscribe request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the unsubscribe request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the unsubscribe operation.

x-processing-time.description: This header indicates the total time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request.
